idea-plugin.name: Immobilienanzeige GEG 87 Lint
idea-plugin.description:
13 rules over German property-ad HTML: the five mandatory Section 87 GModG fields, the ten-year certificate limit, and the Anlage 10 class band that has to match the kWh value. The bundled broken Leipzig template returns seven findings, among them 182 kWh/(m2*a) printed as class C when Anlage 10 makes it class F.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Immobilienanzeige GEG 87 Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 13 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/geg-87-listing-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/geg-87-listing-lint
